entry.intro: Three to seven players (four is usual), one deck, and the lowest score wins. Computer players can fill any empty seats.

lobby.share: Share this code, or the invite link, with your friends. Empty seats can be filled by computer players.
lobby.jack: Jack of Diamonds is worth -5 to whoever takes it
lobby.moon: Shooting the moon (all the hearts and the Queen of Spades)

status.waitingOthersChoose: Waiting for the others to choose their cards.
status.waitingReady: Waiting for {names} to be ready for the next hand.
status.handOver: Hand {n} is over: close the scores to carry on.
status.pick: Pick {count} cards, then press the button on the table ({chosen} of {count} chosen).
status.claimable: No one can beat your cards: you cannot lose another trick. Press Claim all to take them.
status.received: The cards you received are outlined in green.
status.moonOthers: {name} shot the moon: everyone else scores +{points}.

log.claims: {name} claims the remaining {count} trick. | {name} claims the remaining {count} tricks.

errors.moonSetting: Shooting the moon must score +26 for everyone else, or -26 for the shooter.
errors.notTimeToPass: It is not time to pass cards.

errors.passFromHand: You can only pass cards from your hand.
errors.heartsNotBroken: Hearts have not been broken yet.
errors.noPointsFirstTrick: No points on the first trick.
